purpose: Generated illustrative category photographs for the DutyFreeDeal demonstration. These images represent departments, not real product offers.

assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: category photograph for the premium DutyFreeDeal marketplace, for the kitchen department.
Primary request: Create one realistic premium editorial product photograph illustrating this department.
Subject: A brushed stainless-steel espresso machine, a compact cream toaster, an elegant saucepan and wooden cooking utensils, arranged together on a warm ivory kitchen counter.
Scene/backdrop: Warm neutral pale ivory and beige environment with real tactile surfaces and natural soft shadows.
Style/medium: Photorealistic editorial catalog photography, understated and polished, realistic material detail, no illustration or synthetic 3D-render appearance.
Composition/framing: Landscape 3:2 image. All important objects centered in the middle 65 percent of the frame, with generous empty breathing room around the whole composition so the website can crop this photograph as a cover. Products must remain fully recognizable at small thumbnail size. Camera at a gentle three-quarter angle, cohesive still-life rather than a collage.
Lighting/mood: Soft natural daylight, calm premium atmosphere, gentle realistic shadows.
Constraints: One photograph only. No people, no faces, no animals, no text, no numbers, no logos, no brand markings, no watermark, no UI. Plain unbranded products. Keep the color palette warm neutral and restrained.
assets.inspection: Visually inspected: warm neutral photorealistic landscape department still life, no people, text or visible logos; suitable for cover cropping.
